plan.title: English Auction Ceiling and Bidding Views

steps.note: Open the single-stage creation flow requested by the case.
Enable the tenant capability required for auction ceiling prices, although no catalog step can configure the ceiling itself.
Enable eRFX project creation as required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Configure the closest supported auction mode; English rising with a ceiling is not available in the catalog.
Provide the mandatory event title for publishing.
Apply the first available auction template so the pricing sheet is created.
Add the requested product and quantity.
Set the requested delivery location in the first row.
Invite three QA vendors without inventing vendor names.
Publish the auction so vendors can bid.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Submit the first vendor bid at 100 using the vendor portal.
Verify that the first vendor bid was accepted.
Submit the next vendor's bid at 105 using a separate configured vendor identity.
Verify that the second vendor bid was accepted.
Assert the buyer sees two direct vendor responses out of three invited vendors.
